reason: Complete local proof strategy: Introduce one vertex per wire and one fixed-alphabet tuple vertex per gate. Binary projection relations connect each tuple coordinate to its wire vertex; a loop or unary-coded binary relation restricts tuple labels to the gate truth table and forces output one. Use a fixed 8-symbol alphabet with wire labels restricted to 0,1, while retaining named raw input vertices. This uses O(m+n) binary constraints. If raw input x is not satisfying, every auxiliary labeling violates at least one constraint, so UNSAT≥1/M≥δ(x,SAT(C))/M, even if SAT(C) is empty under δ=1. A satisfying input extends to zero violations.
